title: Wonderful tour, guides were great!
text: The two of us traveled first to Gibraltar, then to Tangier, then back to Seville. The rest on the Gibraltar tour were one-day tours from Seville, so we were on our own after they left for Seville. Luca, our guide at Gibraltar, was very informative. Note: Be ready to walk, a lot, in Gibraltar. After Gibraltar, the transfer to the taxi to the ferry went well, as did the meet at the ferry terminal with the tickets.
